title: Lyrics Carousel
subtitle: Nothing is playing
hint: Changes apply live. In text mode the font restarts the window.
settings.font_family.label: Font family
settings.font_family.description: Font used for the lyrics. Image mode accepts any font; text mode only accepts monospaced ones.
settings.font_size.label: Font size
settings.font_size.description: Size of the lyrics in pixels.
settings.render_mode.label: Rendering mode
settings.render_mode.description: Text: drawn by the terminal. Image: drawn with Pillow, allows other line sizes and any font.
settings.direction.label: Scroll direction
settings.direction.description: Down: the lyrics come from the top. Up: the lyrics come from the bottom.
settings.marker.label: Active line marker
settings.marker.description: Show a marker next to the line being sung.
settings.karaoke.label: Karaoke glow
settings.karaoke.description: Light up the active line character by character as the song plays.
settings.equalizer.label: Sound visualiser
settings.footer.label: Time bar
settings.footer.description: Show the elapsed time and the progress bar.
settings.hints.label: Keyboard hints
settings.hints.description: Show the keyboard shortcuts at the bottom.
settings.header.label: Header
settings.header.description: Show the title, the artist and the status tags.
settings.spacing.label: Line spacing
settings.animation_ms.label: Transition
settings.animation_ms.description: Duration of the scroll between lines, in milliseconds. 0 = instant.
settings.ghost.label: Soft transitions
settings.ghost.description: Dim the block slightly while it moves for a softer feel.
settings.offset_ms.label: Lyrics offset
settings.offset_ms.description: Shift the lyrics in milliseconds to fine tune the sync.
settings.width.label: Window width
settings.width.description: Width of the terminal window in pixels.
settings.height.label: Window height
settings.height.description: Height of the terminal window in pixels.
settings.anchor.label: Window position
settings.anchor.description: Where the window opens: center, top-left, bottom-right...
settings.accent.label: Active line colour
settings.accent.description: The primary colour follows the wallpaper; the rest are ANSI colours from the theme.
settings.custom_color.label: Custom colour
settings.custom_color.description: Hex colour (#rrggbb) used when the accent is "custom".
settings.active_scale.label: Active line size
settings.active_scale.description: Size multiplier of the line being sung (image mode only).
settings.visible_above.label: Visible lines above
settings.visible_below.label: Visible lines below
settings.visible_above.description: How many lines are drawn above the active line.
settings.visible_below.description: How many lines are drawn below the active line.
settings.glyph.label: Bar glyph
